description: Dependency freshness per ADR-0011: Go modules, GitHub Actions (pinned to commit digests), mise toolchain, and release-tooling versions pinned in workflows. Weekly cadence, grouped PRs.

packageRules.description: Group non-major Go module updates into one weekly PR
Group GitHub Actions updates (kept pinned to full commit SHAs by config:best-practices)
Group release-tooling updates (cyclonedx-gomod, melange, apko, crane) pinned via *_VERSION in workflows
The SLSA trusted-builder reusable workflows MUST stay referenced by vX.Y.Z tag: slsa-verifier rejects hash-pinned builder refs (ADR-0011 documented exception)

customManagers.description: Track tool versions pinned as *_VERSION env vars in workflows via `# renovate:` hint comments
Track tool versions pinned as `go run <module>@<version>` in mise tasks (e.g. govulncheck) via the same `# renovate:` hint comments
